reply.emotion: bright and warm, thinking of long sunny days and holidays
notes: In traditional or poetic contexts, 'лето' can also mean 'year', as in 'сколько тебе лет?' (how old are you?).

senses.definition: The warmest season of the year, coming between spring and autumn.

examples.text: Мы поедем на море этим летом.
examples.translation: We will go to the sea this summer.
examples.emotion: excited and happy about upcoming vacation plans

senses.definition: A year of a person's life, used mostly in poetry or set phrases.

examples.text: Ему пошел двадцатый год от роду, пошел двадцатый век, пошло двадцатое лето.
examples.translation: He was in his twentieth year.
examples.emotion: reflective and literary, speaking of the passage of time
